description:
Request an OTP code.

Sometimes OTP is needed to complete invoking a tool. When tool invocation fails due to OTP reasons, you will be
notified in the tool response, and be asked to rqeuest an OTP code.

Only call after a tool call fails due to OTP. In clients that show apps, the user enters the code in a card
shown with the result, and the result says so.
name: request_otp
title: Request OTP
